## Purpose

Display all current key-value pairs in the agentic-devtools state store.

## Prerequisites

No prerequisites required.

## Actions

1. Run the command:

   ```bash
   agdt-show
   ```

## Expected Outcome

All state key-value pairs are printed to stdout.
